title: AI Summary App Settings
description: Global connection settings for the waibee AI service. Configured by a system administrator on the app's Settings tab, never exposed to the browser.

waibeeEndpoint.title: waibee API base URL
waibeeEndpoint.description: Base URL of the waibee service, e.g. https://api.waibee.example.com (chat completions are requested at <baseUrl>/v1/chat/completions)

waibeeApiKey.title: waibee API key
waibeeApiKey.description: Secret API key used to authenticate requests to waibee. Only readable from backend scripts via ctx.settings.waibeeApiKey.

waibeeModel.title: waibee model
waibeeModel.description: Model id to send in the chat completion request, in "<provider>/<model>" form (e.g. waibee/auto, anthropic/claude-opus-5). See <baseUrl>/v1/models for the full list.
